verses.text: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost, and to call sinners to repentance; but these little ones have no need of repentance, and I will save them.

title: JST, Matthew 18:11. Compare Matthew 18:11 ; see also Moroni 8 Little children have no need of repentance.
